lines.text: The Israelites broke the sacred pillars and tore down the high places throughout Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim and Manasseh.
Hezekiah gave from his own possessions for the offerings and commanded Jerusalem's people to contribute for the priests and Levites.
The Israelites generously brought firstfruits of grain, new wine, oil and figs, and laid them in large heaps.
Azariah told Hezekiah the LORD had blessed His people, and Hezekiah ordered altars prepared in the LORD's house.
Hezekiah did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God, and he prospered.
